facts.business: Enviro Infra Engineers Limited is a technology-driven company operating in water, wastewater, and renewable energy infrastructure, delivering EPC solutions for STPs, CETPs, and tertiary treatment, while building an IPP portfolio of solar and battery storage assets through its subsidiary EIE Renewables Private Limited.

segments.name: Renewable Energy Platform (IPP & EPC via EIE Renewables Private Limited)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Targeting a 75:25 mix of EPC and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) projects
